text: Concatenate input vectors of same data type for iterative processing, 2 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Type of concatenation Vector; {Number of inputs} sets the number of input ports and {Concatenate dimension} sets the output dimension along which to concatenate input arrays scalar.
